ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This online course will use Compass for asynchronous and Collaborate for synchronous sessions. Collaborate online synchronous class sessions will be held on Thursdays from 5 to 6:20 pm. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to non-residential, nondegree students only. Students in this section will meet with students in the ART 100 JB section during the online synchronous class sessions.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $402.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
